system.description: You have convinced your local Kindred community that you are a full member of a clan despite your true ancestry (typically Caitiff or thin-blooded), and are treated as a full member of undead society rather than a half-person, so long as you maintain the illusion. Which clan you claim depends on you, but one slip can turn things very unpleasant — most clans are unforgiving toward those who fool them this way, and being caught passing as clanned is considered worse than simply being clanless.
